label: Korean / Chinese / TW / HK female-hypnosis research
group_title: Korea, China, Taiwan & Hong Kong — female hypnotised (Oct 2026)
description: Korean and Chinese-language (incl. Taiwan and Hong Kong) films, series, daily dramas and vertical shorts where an adult female character is hypnotised (hypnosis, mesmerism or a hypnotic device; possession and black magic excluded). Records carry hypnotist, motive, method, pregnant_end / pregnancy_outcome, kids_together (does the couple end up with children) and kids_status (children before the story), plus per-episode notes for series. Adults only; non-explicit notes.

records.title: Hypnotized Hypnotist (被催眠的催眠师)
records.meta: Web series · China · Mandarin · 19 episodes · premiered 13 Apr 2017 · dir. Tan Jiayan
records.character: Xia Ye 夏曳 (Kong Mu's fiancée) and policewoman Song Yi 宋奕
records.summary: Republican-era Tianhai. Hypnotist Kong Mu discovers that his fiancée Xia Ye has been placed under the 'Pan Si Rao' (盘丝绕) hypnosis by the leader of a Japanese hypnotist sect and made to frame his ally. Policewoman Song Yi is also put into trance by Kong Mu to clear a drug reaction, and later breaks a group hypnosis in the finale.
records.hypnotist: The sect leader (宗主) of a Japanese hypnotist organisation hypnotises Xia Ye; Kong Mu hypnotises Xia Ye to read her trance-dream, and Song Yi to treat her; Meng Qingsong traps the group in a hypnotic realm in the finale
records.method: Hypnosis (the 'Pan Si Rao' binding technique; trance-dream entry; a totem object in the finale)

episodes.gist: Song Yi swallows a hallucinogenic drug; Kong Mu hypnotises her to undo its effects and watches over her. Suspicion falls on Xia Ye.
Kong Mu hypnotises Xia Ye and finds her bound by 'Pan Si Rao' inside her trance; she admits that her controller made her plant drugs on Ouyang Feng. He makes her forget the session.
The sect leader orders the entranced Xia Ye to kill Meng Hai, and she hesitates. Meng Qingsong traps the group in a hypnotic 'sea of sand', and Song Yi breaks it. Xia Ye is freed and leaves the city.

records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy in the episode recaps.
records.kids_together_note: Xia Ye has no children and leaves alone. Kong Mu ends up with Song Yi; no children are mentioned.

sources.label: Douban (via Baidu snippet): 被催眠的催眠师

records.note: Per-episode air dates were not found, so only the premiere date is given.
records.provenance: Korean/Chinese/TW/HK female-hypnosis pass, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; non-explicit notes)

records.title: Hyde, Jekyll, Me (하이드 지킬, 나)
records.meta: TV series · South Korea · Korean · SBS · 20 episodes (21 Jan – 26 Mar 2015)
records.summary: Circus worker Ha-na sees hypnotherapist Yoon Tae-joo (secretly Lee Soo-hyun, bent on revenge on Seo-jin). Over about twelve sessions he hypnotises her: he extracts what she knows about Seo-jin's third personality and plants a command that makes her phone lure Robin into a trap.
records.method: Hypnotherapy sessions plus post-hypnotic programming; a hypnotic song is also used on the police

episodes.gist: Tae-joo reveals he has hypnotised Ha-na in twelve sessions. He hypnotises her to learn about 'Terry' and uses her phone to text Robin to a theatre trap.
Tae-joo, unmasked, uses a hypnotic song on the police and escapes, then kidnaps Ha-na at the episode's end.

records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy in the recaps or the series synopsis.
records.provenance: Korean/Chinese/TW/HK female-hypnosis pass, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; non-explicit notes)

records.title: Alchemy of Souls (환혼)
records.subtitle: Part 1 finale · Mudeok bell hypnosis
records.meta: TV series · South Korea · Korean · tvN · Part 1, 20 episodes
records.summary: Jin Mu learns that the assassin Naksu's soul is inside Mudeok's body and hypnotises her. In the trance she kills Jin Woo-tak and stabs her beloved Jang Uk. When she comes to, he hypnotises her again with the bell that controls soul-shifters, and she disappears into the lake.
records.method: Hypnosis via a soul-shifter control bell (a fantasy device)

episodes.gist: The hypnotised Mudeok kills Jin Woo-tak and stabs Jang Uk on a wedding day; Jin Mu re-hypnotises her with the bell and she vanishes into the lake.

records.pregnancy_note: No pregnancy in the Part 1 finale.
records.evidence: single source — ZAPZEE recap (Wikipedia confirms the series)
records.fit_note: The control comes from a fantasy 'soul-shifter bell', a hypnotic device in a magic setting. It is not possession or black magic, but it is a loose fit.
records.provenance: Korean/Chinese/TW/HK female-hypnosis pass, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; non-explicit notes)
